linux.protocol: Same benchmarks and protocol as the macOS runs: three process runs, median of per-run medians. baseline = commit 7630cd43 with the system allocator (glibc); round2 = 049c52c7 (shared planner parameters and the parameter-free nesting check) with glibc; final = 9b75409c (also exact-length parameter arrays, the once-validated rule registry, and mimalloc as the allocator).
linux.verification: fmt, workspace clippy, all-target clippy of the AST and planner crates, and the helix-ast, derive, bench, planner, db lib (2,545 tests), server and production-contract suites pass on Graviton4.

protocol: divan 0.1.21; each parse/stage benchmark max_time 1 s and each throughput benchmark max_time 2 s per argument; three independent process runs; reported value is the median of the three per-run medians. Memory figures are requested bytes from a calling-thread counting allocator, one deterministic run. The baseline parse figures are one run at f94237a5, before parameter validation became lazy.

simd_json_switch.note: Requested bytes from ast_memory (allocator independent), so comparable with linux.memory.final, which is sonic-rs at 9b75409c.
